summary: The registered seven-control analysis agrees in direction with all 107 paired S1 effects, covering 107/132 selected genes (81.06%). Omitting control rep5 (GSM1201496) alone recovers the paper's expressed-gene count and, with joint DESeq normalization, all 107 paired effects to two decimals. Among 13 additional candidate loci checked in the deposited counts, 11 reproduce S1 and each of the CXCL1 and CXCL3 candidates gives the value printed for the other.

manualReview.summary: Selected RA/C effects compared. The inferred six-control cohort reproduces the registered pairs' S1 values, with two additional gene identities unresolved.
manualReview.note: Matthews et al. describe 7 restricted-anovulatory (RA), 7 restricted-ovulatory (RO) and 6 higher-feed control (C) heifers. GEO, BioStudies and ENA inventory seven libraries per group. Of 15,410 deposited genes with at least five reads in any sample, 115 reach five only in GSM1201496. Of the seven single-control omissions, only rep5 gives the published 15,295 genes. Across the 107 S1 rows paired to registered effects, a joint three-group reconstruction of DESeq 1.1.11 base-mean ratios recovers 107 printed effects after that omission and two using all 21 libraries. The paper gives neither a GSM-level design nor an exclusion rationale. Its Table 1 sequencing and assigned-fragment averages remain unreconciled. Thirteen more S1 labels each have one current bovine Gene ID linked to a single release-59 candidate in the deposited counts. Eleven candidates reproduce S1 to two decimals. The CXCL1 candidate yields 1.32 (S1 0.95) and the CXCL3 candidate yields 0.95 (S1 1.32). These assignments remain open. The registered edgeR-QL model compares seven RA against all seven C. Feeding level and ovulatory status both differ. Of 132 selected annotated effects, 107 pair to reported coefficients. All 107 directions agree, Pearson is 0.978780, Spearman is 0.966815 and the median absolute log2 difference is 0.069664. The paper reports 137 calls at BH FDR 0.10 (69 up, 68 down). S1 lists 65 up and 67 down with no numeric P or adjusted P. None of the 11,831 published registered rows meets FDR < 0.10. Selected coverage and cohort compatibility fall short of author-concordance-v2.
reviewFlags: The paper reports six controls. The count filter and rounded effects point to omission of GSM1201496 under a single-control exclusion. The registered model includes it.
Only 107 of 132 selected S1 effects have supported registered pairs. The CXCL1 and CXCL3 raw-count candidates each give the value S1 prints for the other and both lack a published registered symbol.

The author design file, per-gene P values and adjusted P values are unavailable in the reviewed materials. The Table 1 means for sequenced and assigned fragments cannot be reconciled by omitting one deposited control under like-for-like averaging.

verificationReview.reason: The selected RA/C comparison is complete for 107 of 132 S1 genes. Both numerical v2 routes meet their cutoffs on those pairs, but coverage is 81.06% and the registered cohort has an additional control. Evidence points to GSM1201496 as the omitted control. Two additional historical loci each give the S1 value printed for the other gene, and the paper supplies no stable IDs for those rows. The detailed review remains open on gene attribution and the Table 1 averages.
verificationReview.nextStep: Request the original DESeq table keyed by Ensembl ID, including CXCL1 and CXCL3, raw and adjusted P values, and the design identifying included libraries. Ask which libraries and processing stage contributed to the two Table 1 averages and whether control rep5 was excluded from DESeq.

comparabilityReview.basis: Current R 4.6.0 edgeR-QL case coefficient for restricted-anovulatory versus higher-feed ovulatory heifers, seven per arm. The separate DESeq base-mean reconstruction tests the inferred sample omission.
comparabilityReview.reference: Matthews et al., Table S1, 132 annotated selected RA/C log2 fold changes. The footnote defines RA relative to C.

cohort.note: The paper describes seven RA and six C, while the registered fit uses seven RA and seven C. Of the seven possible single-control omissions, only GSM1201496 recovers 15,295 expressed genes. Joint normalization then reproduces the 107 registered-pair S1 values at two decimals. Sample membership is inferred and the rationale is undocumented.

contrast.note: Both effects compare whole hypothalamus from restricted-diet anovulatory heifers with higher-feed ovulatory controls. The contrast combines diet and reproductive status. RO animals are outside these effect groups.

features.note: 102 exact symbols and five aliases pair to registered coefficients. Each alias has independent bovine authority support, a single release-59 locus and a unique 14-library count trace. The 25 unpaired labels remain in identifier-review.tsv. An additional raw-count check finds that each CXCL1/CXCL3 candidate gives the value S1 prints for the other gene. Their attribution is unresolved.

effects.note: Both effects are log2(RA/C), orientation +1. Registered comparisons agree in direction for 107/107 pairs. Pearson 0.978780, Spearman 0.966815 and median absolute difference 0.069664 describe the selected pairs.

inference.note: The paper used DESeq 1.1.11 and BH FDR 0.10. It reports 137 calls. Zero of the 11,831 published edgeR-QL rows meet FDR < 0.10, including zero of the 107 pairs. S1 supplies no numeric P or adjusted P. The reconstruction evaluates normalized base-mean ratios.

coverage.note: 107/132 selected S1 effects paired (81.06%), corresponding to 107/11,831 published registered rows. The complete author testing universe is unavailable. The 25 unpaired rows remain in the reference denominator.

comparabilityReview.criteria: Use all finite S1 effects in their published orientation, unique identifiers and the unchanged registered coefficient. Author-concordance-v2 requires at least 30 pairs, 90% selected-reference coverage and compatible cohort, contrast, identifiers and effects, together with its correlation or nonzero-direction rule.
comparabilityReview.conclusion: The registered comparison closes at selected-effect scope. Both v2 numerical effect criteria pass on the paired rows. The study falls short of v2 because coverage is 107/132 and the cohorts differ. The separate raw-count reconstruction leaves CXCL1/CXCL3 attribution unresolved. No contrast receives full verification.

additionalComparisonSpec.orientation: S1 footnote and registered groupcase coefficient both express restricted-anovulatory relative to control.
additionalComparisonSpec.note: Replacement for the existing GSE49540 S1 comparison using all 132 published log2(RA/C) effects. There are 102 exact-symbol and five source-traced pairs. Twenty-five rows remain in the denominator. A separate reconstruction identifies GSM1201496 as the only single-control omission consistent with the expressed-gene count. Outside the registered pairs, the CXCL1 and CXCL3 candidates each give the S1 value for the other gene. Neither is assigned a registered effect. S1 provides no numeric P or adjusted P.

openIssues: The paper gives six controls but no sample-level design or explanation for the inferred omission of GSM1201496. Its Table 1 means for sequenced and assigned fragments do not match any single-control omission under like-for-like averaging.
The original stable IDs behind the CXCL1 and CXCL3 S1 labels are unknown. Each candidate locus gives the S1 value for the other gene, and the registered feature map lists both as dropped_no_symbol.
Twenty-five of 132 selected S1 effects lack a supported registered pair. The reviewed sources give neither the full author DESeq result nor numeric gene-level P or adjusted P.
